gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-sc: Noto Sans SC reads modern and unfussy, its chalk-like curves stopping short of closing and its ascenders barely clearing the lowercase. Flavors brings the whimsy, with diagonals as hefty as its stems.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-siddha: Almendra Display sets an ornate, literary tone, its letters never pinching shut and its lowercase standing tall. And Noto Sans Siddham answers in a friendlier sans, with a large central band and an s whose ends hang wide.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Audiowide draws every stroke at fixed pressure, with no thick-thin shift, and its glyphs sit like tiles with wide grout between them. Noto Sans Sharada reads clean over a long stretch.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Eater's thin strokes are barely lighter than its stems, and wide gaps separate the letters, giving it a dark, aggressive edge. But Noto Sans Sinhala lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase that feels steady line after line.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Flavors looks bent from a single length of wire, its lowercase towering like a stubby carpenter's pencil stroke. And Noto Sans Soyombo steps in with a sizable x-height and open-mouthed curves, so headings and text share the page easily.
gen-fs-bonny-satoshi: Satoshi reads soaring and approachable, its e wide open and every stroke cut like cord. Bonny sits quieter, with gentle stroke contrast and tight-set lines, so Satoshi's text feels fresh and breezy paragraph after paragraph.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-sunuwa: Noto Sans Sunuwar is clean and approachable, its curves leaving daylight. Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters, so give the body font a generous size and let its short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies do the quiet work.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Noto Sans Sundanese keeps its e crossbars open and its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, against Audiowide's strokes like a bent steel rod. It reads smooth and unhurried.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Noto Sans Syloti Nagri reads clean, with short ascenders, a tall x-height and an a whose lower bowl opens to breathe. Eater is the dark, aggressive one, with thin strokes only slightly lighter than its thick ones, while Noto Sans Syloti Nagri handles the steady reading.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Flavors holds an unvarying line thickness, with diagonals as hefty as its stems and a towering, pencil-stub x-height. Noto Sans Syriac softens it with blown-glass bowls and easy s turns.
